info.title: AxioRank Gateway API
info.description:
The runtime governance API behind every AxioRank SDK. Call it directly from any language. All requests authenticate with a bearer token and send/receive JSON.

The SDKs (`@axiorank/sdk`, `axiorank` on PyPI) are thin wrappers over these endpoints. The canonical base path is `/api/v1`; the unversioned `/api/...` paths remain as aliases.

post.description: Inspect an outbound agent tool call, score its risk, apply your policies, and return a decision. Requires the `gateway:write` scope. When a `require_approval` policy fires the decision is `hold` and an `approvalId` is returned. Poll `GET /api/gateway/approvals/{approvalId}` for the resolution.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Safely retry a write: the first response for a given key is replayed on retries (24h TTL). A concurrent retry gets 409; reusing a key with a different body gets 422.

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is already in progress.

422.description: Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body.

get.description: When a tool call returns `decision: "hold"`, poll this endpoint with the `approvalId` until a human resolves it. The server long-polls (~8s per request), so polling is cheap. Authenticate with the SAME agent key that made the call; another agent's holds return an opaque 404.

200.description: The current approval state. `decision` stays `hold` while pending.

404.description: Unknown approval, or not owned by this agent.

post.description: Verify an external MCP server / A2A agent card before trusting it. Supply EITHER a `url` to fetch the card from OR an inline `document` (one is required). Returns the resolved identity (signature validity, key domain-binding), declared capabilities, auth, and a decision. Requires the `cards:verify` scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Safely retry a write: the first response for a given key is replayed on retries (24h TTL). A concurrent retry gets 409; reusing a key with a different body gets 422.

400.description: Malformed body, or neither `url` nor `document` supplied.

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is already in progress.

422.description: Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body.

post.description: Verify an inbound agent request against a property's site key (bot management). The `axioGuard` middleware builds this call for you. Authenticate with an `axr_site_…` key (scope `inbound:verify`); the visiting agent's own HTTP Message Signature travels inside the body, not in this call's auth.

Exchange a long-lived credential for a short-lived, scoped `axr_tok_…` token (tokens can only NARROW scopes, never widen them). Two grants: **key exchange**, present an `axr_live_`/`axr_test_` key in the `Authorization` header; **federated**, present a platform OIDC token as `subject_token` in the body (no AxioRank secret stored on the agent).

403.description: Requested scopes are not permitted by the credential.

post.summary: Verdict for a proxied MCP tools/call
post.description: Lightweight verdict endpoint the local stdio shim (`@axiorank/mcp-gateway`) calls per `tools/call`. `server` is the registered server slug. `phase: "request"` inspects the call arguments; `phase: "result"` inspects the tool output and requires `resultText`. Requires the `gateway:write` scope.

404.description: Unknown MCP server slug for this agent.

get.description: Stream redacted audit-log rows as newline-delimited JSON (`application/x-ndjson`), one row per line, keyset-paginated by `(created_at, id)`. Follow the `x-axiorank-next-cursor` response header to page. Requires the `logs:read` scope and a Pro plan or above (`siemExport`).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO timestamp for the start of the window.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO timestamp for the end of the window.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from the previous page.

200.description: NDJSON stream of redacted audit rows.

x-axiorank-next-cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

403.description: Missing `logs:read` scope or plan does not include SIEM export.

get.description: The Ed25519 public keys (active + retired) that sign audit receipts and signed tree heads. PUBLIC and unauthenticated by design: pin a key by `kid` out-of-band, then verify a receipt against it offline with the open-source `@axiorank/audit-verify` package. That independence from AxioRank is the whole point.

200.description: A JWKS of the log signing keys.

post.description: Convenience verifier: POST a receipt and get the per-check result. This is NOT the trust anchor - the authoritative path is the open-source verifier run against a key you pinned out-of-band, which needs no trust in this endpoint. Public and rate-limited.

get.summary: Signed tree head for a checkpoint
get.description: Fetch the signed tree head (STH) for one of your workspace's sealed checkpoints by its sequence number. A monitor pins the STH series over time to detect a retroactive edit. Requires the `logs:read` scope; the workspace is taken from the key, so an STH series is never cross-tenant.

200.description: The signed tree head for that checkpoint.

404.description: Unknown checkpoint, or it predates the Merkle upgrade.

get.summary: Issue an offline-verifiable receipt for an audit row
get.description: Issue a self-contained receipt for one of your workspace's audit rows: inclusion proof + signed tree head + signed provenance, verifiable offline with `@axiorank/audit-verify`. Requires the `logs:read` scope; the workspace is taken from the key. Returns an envelope with `status` (ok, pending_seal, purged, unavailable) and, when ok, the `receipt`.

get.summary: Public checkpoint series for a monitored log
get.description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated: the signed-tree-head series for a workspace that opted into public monitoring, keyed by its opaque log id. Anyone can pull the series and independently watch for equivocation or rollback (the `@axiorank/log-watchdog` daemon does this). Only hashes, counts, timestamps, signatures, and witness records are exposed, never audit content.

200.description: A page of checkpoints, ascending by sequence.

404.description: Unknown log id, or monitoring is not enabled.

get.summary: Latest head for a monitored log
get.description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated: the current head for an opted-in workspace's log. A monitor fetches this each interval; a seq that goes backward, or a changed root/signature at a known seq, signals equivocation.

404.description: Unknown log id, or no checkpoints sealed yet.

get.summary: One checkpoint by sequence for a monitored log
get.description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated: re-fetch a specific head a monitor pinned earlier and confirm it is byte-identical.
Public uptime probe. Reports DB reachability without leaking data; returns 503 when degraded.
Public, machine-readable matrix of the agent-interop protocols AxioRank speaks.

200.description: Coverage summary, planes, and per-protocol detail.

post.description: Streamable-HTTP proxy to a registered upstream MCP server. The body is a JSON-RPC 2.0 message; AxioRank inspects, audits, and polices `tools/call` before forwarding. Authenticated with a per-server URL token (or the governing agent's Bearer key), NOT the standard gateway scopes.

401.description: Missing or invalid server token / key.

get.description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated. The directory of MCP servers observed in the tool-definition transparency log. Server-published metadata only (no tenant identity).

200.description: Observed servers and their latest tool-definition hashes.

get.description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated. The full tool-definition history for one MCP server: every observed state and signed diff event. A rug-pull appears here as a publicly provable change event.

404.description: Server not found in the log.

get.description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated. One tool-definition log entry: the normalized tool set, per-tool hashes, and the diff if it is a change event.
PUBLIC, unauthenticated. An offline-verifiable inclusion proof for one entry (inclusion path plus the signed tree head), so any client can verify a server's tool history against the published key.

200.description: The inclusion proof + signed tree head.

409.description: Entry not sealed into a checkpoint yet.

get.summary: Tool-definition transparency log: signed tree head
get.description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated. The current signed tree head of the tool-definition log. Pin it over time to confirm the log only ever grows.

bearerAuth.description: An AxioRank API key (`axr_live_…` agent key or `axr_site_…` property key) or a short-lived token (`axr_tok_…`). Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Scopes: `gateway:write`, `cards:verify`, `inbound:verify`, `logs:read`, `admin`.

RiskSignal.description: A redacted content-inspection finding that contributed to the risk score.

evidence.description: Redacted evidence, safe to persist and display.

critical.description: A live secret / key / card was detected.

approvalId.description: Present ONLY when decision is `hold`. Poll GET /api/gateway/approvals/{id}.

ifc.description: True when this workspace enforces information-flow control. The SDK uses it to decide whether to report untrusted tool results (phase="result") for taint tracking.

protocol.description: Resolved protocol of the card (a2a, mcp, oauth, …).

signatureValid.description: true = verified · false = forged · null = unsigned / key unresolvable.

confidence.description: 0..100: cryptographic proof = 100, heuristic UA match = 40, etc.

enforced.description: false under `monitor` posture: the verdict was computed + logged, not acted on.
true when the call must NOT be forwarded as-is under `enforce` posture.

approvalId.description: Present when decision is `hold` under enforce.

status.description: Approval state: `pending` while awaiting a human; `approved`/`denied` once resolved; `expired` on timeout.

resolvedBy.description: Operator who resolved the hold, if any.

SignedTreeHead.description: An Ed25519-signed Merkle tree head over a sealed checkpoint window.

merkleRoot.description: Hex RFC 6962 root over the window's row hashes.

prevCheckpointHash.description: Binds the STH into the append-only chain.

checkpointHash.description: This checkpoint's own hash, signed on self-anchored (v2) heads. Absent on v1.

keyId.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the signing key (JWKS lookup id).

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 over the canonical STH.

AuditReceipt.description: A self-contained, offline-verifiable proof for one audit row.

rowHash.description: Hex SHA-256 over the row's immutable fields.

provenance.description: The Ed25519-signed delegation-provenance token (who authorized the action).

PublicKeyResponse.description: JWKS of the transparency-log signing keys (active + retired). Pin a key by kid.

rowBinding.description: Null unless the row is supplied.

inclusion.description: Proof folds to the signed Merkle root.

approver.description: Every human-approval signature verifies (null if none present).

reason.description: Present only when ok is false.

WitnessRecord.description: An independent witness co-signature over a signed tree head (split-view defense).

keyId.description: Pinned witness key / log id used to verify the countersignature.

subjectHash.description: Hex SHA-256 over the canonical STH: binds the record to this head.

signature.description: The witness countersignature (for rekor, the SET).

PublicCheckpoint.description: A public checkpoint head: the signed tree head plus its chain fields and witnesses.

signedTreeHead.description: The stored signed tree head, or null for a legacy checkpoint.

purged.description: Rows purged under retention; the signed head still proves the window.
